title: Bolder hand: foreign forms for Dash AI's OSS homepage
question: Bolder register: no grounded directions this round. The roll leads with the Character Catalog. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again. Every world keeps the navy and violet slash.

options.label: The Character Catalog
options.lineage: character goods catalog pages: rounded mascots, name plates, birthdays
options.thesis: Every project is a character with a name plate, a birthday and one line about what it does.
options.viewport: A pastel grid of project plates: DocMyRepos large with its slash-built character, openspec-hud as a not-yet-hatched plate, the forkflame-* repos as guest samples; each plate shows a real birthday (repo creation date), license and one line, with the GitHub action on the lead plate.
options.risk: Characters are all authored art: the cast has to be drawn from the slash mark, or the grid turns into generic cards. The catalog's popularity ranking is dropped because no real numbers exist.

raised.raise: Each plate carries its literal function in straight quotes, 'DOCS SEARCH', 'OKF FILTERS', so the cute character never hides what the tool does.

options.label: Quoted Industrial Labels
options.lineage: industrial streetwear: quoted words, zip-tie tags, hazard stripes
options.thesis: Name the obvious in big quotes: "DOCS", "SEARCH", "SELF-HOSTED".
options.viewport: Giant navy caps in straight quotes ("DOCS FOR EVERY REPO") over white; a diagonal stripe band crosses the first screen; stenciled label plates for MIT, LIVE and COMING SOON; GitHub action as a tag.
options.case: Wins on clarity: every zone is named by what it is. Loses on audience identification: developers do not identify with a workwear aesthetic. Orange tags translated to the brand violet.
options.risk: Hazard stripes can read as warning or error to developers.

options.label: Bound Volumes on a Shelf
options.lineage: skeuomorph leather studio: stitched leather, linen, shelf wood
options.thesis: The org is a shelf and each repo is a bound volume you pull down and open.
options.viewport: Two bound volumes on a shelf, DocMyRepos pulled forward with a violet ribbon; its open page carries the real screenshot, and the GitHub action is a ribbon pull.
options.case: Wins on product clarity: docs as books is the mechanism itself. Loses on audience identification: heavy skeuomorphism reads dated to developers. Tan leather and walnut translated to navy cloth and linen.
options.risk: Skeuomorph texture work is expensive in CSS and ages fast.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: One bitmap line at a time over a black void, rank is depth, nothing is boxed.
options.viewport: A dead-still ivory line 'DOCMYREPOS' in front, project names drifting on baselines behind it at slower rates, no boxes or rules; the GitHub action is the frontmost reversed glyph cell.
options.case: Wins on audience identification: developers read it as their own folklore. Loses on product clarity: baselines say nothing about search or docs unless the real docs tree scrolls through them.
options.risk: Terminal and hacker aesthetic is the predictable dev-tool reading.

options.label: Night Instrument Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six calm dials, each owning one truth.
options.case: Fuses poorly: gauges need live values and the project has no stats to show without inventing them.
options.kept: Each element owns exactly one truth: one status or one fact per plate.

options.label: Layered Papercut
options.thesis: Flat colored papers pasted in layers.
options.case: Fuses weakly: nothing in the product maps to folk symmetry, and developers do not identify with it, though the two-shape Dash mark is a natural cut-paper pair.
options.kept: Depth made only by overlap and never by shadow or tone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean open-source product page: headline, screenshot, feature grid, quickstart.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and GitHub button left, DocMyRepos screenshot right, three feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other OSS landing pages by design.
